169956.productDescription:
The perfect addition to your homemade chili, tamales, or other Mexican-inspired dishes, Bolner’s Ancho Chili Pods are rich in robust flavor.
Ancho chili pods are simply dried poblano peppers. The poblano pepper is native to the state of Puebla, Mexico and they are a type of mild chili pepper. Though green ancho chiles are mild and robust in flavor, ripe red chiles can be incredibly hot and flavorful. Ancho chiles are used in a variety of Mexican-style dishes including mole sauces, tamales, enchiladas and even chili. Because Bolner’s Ancho Chili Pods are dried, they will retain their heat and flavor until you reconstitute them with hot water. Then they are ready to use in all of your favorite soups, sauces and Mexican-style dishes. BE sure to test the chiles before using them – you may be surprised by how hot they can get!
169956.categoryPath: H-E-B > Shop > Pantry > Canned & dried food > Vegetables > Peppers

169990.productDescription:
Walk into any Italian restaurant or pizzeria and you’ll see crushed red pepper shakers right next to the salt and pepper.
Red Peppers are made from a fruit being plant within the Capsicum family. The 4 inch pods are fiery red to orange color with a strong bite and an intense heat that escalates during the cooking process.
Native to Mexico, Central America, the West Indies and parts of South America, crushed red pepper adds a mixture of heat, sweetness and smoky flavor that intensifies meals and tantalizes taste buds.
Discovered by the Spanish in the 1400s and then brought to Europe and the New World, crushed red pepper is now used in all different ethic style cuisines. Used whenever a recipe calls for some added favor and a kick of heat, they are often added to spaghetti sauces, chowders, gumbos, soups, stews, sausage and pickling brine, as well as savory fried rice.
Best of all, crushed red pepper flakes are rich with Vitamin C and A. Throughout the ages, they have be used to treat scurvy, kill parasites in the body, and help reduce inflammation, boost immunity, and help promote weight loss.

1211086.productDescription:
It has been said that Oregano was first brought to the West by soldiers stationed in Italy during WWII, who fell in love with its “pizza like” flavor. Since then, Oregano has been an adapted and welcomed addition to many dishes.
Oregano is a culinary that has an aromatic and warm flavor. It combines well with grilled or roasted vegetables, most poultry, and also compliments spicy dishes commonly found south of the border. In Mexican dishes, Oregano is often added to enchiladas, chilies, Mexican beans, soups and many dips.
Many authentic Mexican recipes call specifically for Mexican Oregano; however it is not always the easiest product to find at many of the local American grocery stores or markets. Bolner’s Fiesta brand Oregano uses 100% Mexican Oregano that has been dried to its peak and offers a great substitution for those specific traditional recipes.

170035.productDescription:
If you are looking for the perfect blend of spices to complement your favorite pinto bean dishes, look no further than Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Pinto Bean Seasoning.
Pinto beans are the most common bean eaten in both Mexico and the United States. In Spanish, they carry the name “frijol pinto” which translates to “speckled bean.” Not only can these beans be served mashed or simmered in broth, but they are commonly used to make refried beans for tacos, side dishes and burritos. Pinto beans have a unique flavor all their own, but it can easily be overpowered with seasoning during cooking. Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Pinto Bean Seasoning is a subtle yet delicious blend of garlic, onion, chili peppers, and spices that bring out and complement the natural flavor of tender pinto beans. Simply stir 3 tablespoons of Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Pinto Bean Seasoning into 1 lbs. of pinto beans and simmer for 2 hours until tender.

170059.productDescription:
A flavorful blend of salt, brown sugar, paprika, chilies, and spices, Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Pork Rub is the perfect way to season your favorite cuts of pork.
Pork is sometimes referred to as the “other white meat”, but comparing this meat to others takes away from its unique flavor. Ham, bacon, and sausage are just a few of the many delicious food products that can be made from pork – the same cannot be said for chicken! If you want to bring out the natural flavor of your favorite cuts of pork, season them with Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Pork Rub before cooking. Simply rub a generous portion of the seasoning blend into your favorite cuts of pork and let rest for 30 minutes (or refrigerate overnight) before cooking. To maximize the flavor, use thick cuts of pork and sear them over high heat then reduce the temperature and cook slowly until the internal temperature reaches 170°F.

170015.productDescription:
The perfect blend of chili peppers, garlic, paprika, and spices, Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Quick Chili Mix gives you authentic chili flavor with a fraction the preparation time.
Chili is a dish that originated in Mexico during the 1500s as a spicy stew made with meat, tomatoes, chili peppers and beans. Traditionally, chili is left to simmer for several hours so the meat and beans can absorb the flavor of the seasonings. If you are craving that classic chili flavor but don’t have hours to spare, Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Quick Chili Mix is just what you need!

Salt, garlic and mouth-watering spices combined with a hint of sugar and a pinch of tenderizer make for the perfect rib rub, brought to you from Bolner’s kitchen.
No one can resist a rack of freshly smoked or barbecued ribs, especially when they are prepared using Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Rib Rub. The perfect blend of salt, garlic and spices, this rib rub is guaranteed to bring out the flavor of any type of ribs – beef, pork, even deer! Simply rub the seasoning blend into fresh ribs and let rest for 30 minutes then barbecue slowly until tender. To maximize the flavor, let your ribs chill in the refrigerator overnight after seasoning with Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Rib Rub before cooking. This rib rub is great for all cooking methods including roasting, grilling, frying, baking, braising, smoking and, of course, barbecuing!

169997.productDescription:
A delicious blend of garlic, onion and other spices, Fiesta Brand Salt-Free Fajita Seasoning is just what you need to bring a little authentic flavor to your homemade fajitas.
Fajitas are a type of Tex-Mex cuisine that consists of sautéed peppers and onions served with strips of grilled meat. This dish is often sold sizzling hot in a cast iron skillet with warmed corn tortillas and fresh pico de gallo. Thanks to Fiesta Brand spices, you don’t have to cross the border to enjoy delicious fajitas with authentic flavor. If you are looking for a simple way to make your homemade fajitas taste a little more like the ones you get at your favorite Mexican restaurant, try this Salt-Free Fajita Seasoning. Simple sprinkle it on flank steak or chicken and let it rest 30 minutes before searing over an open flame. Use the seasoning to flavor your fajita vegetables as well and you will have an authentic-tasting Mexican inspired meal!
169997.categoryPath: H-E-B > Shop > Pantry > Spices & seasonings > Spice mixes

170032.displayName: Bolner's Fiesta Salt Free Lemon Pepper
170032.productDescription:
This Lemon Pepper seasoning has all of the zesty lemon and black pepper flavor you love without the added salt – this makes it perfect for individuals following a low-sodium diet.
If you are looking for an easy way to add flavor to your favorite dishes without significantly increasing the sodium content of the dish, try this salt-free Lemon Pepper seasoning blend. Made with fresh lemon zest and ground pepper, augmented with garlic and other spices, this peppery spice blend will impart a pop of flavor on any chicken, seafood or pasta dish. 170017.productDescription:
Completely salt-free, Fiesta Brand Brisket Rub is the ideal blend of garlic, onion, paprika and other spices guaranteed to bring out the best flavor in your favorite brisket.
Brisket is a prime cut of meat that traditionally comes from the lower chest of beef or veal. There are a variety of ways to prepare this cut of meat, but the best way to bring out the flavor is to season it with a dry rub and cook it slowly over the indirect heat of a charcoal or wood grill. Fiesta Brand Brisket Rub is the perfect blend of garlic, onion, paprika and other spices – including a tenderizing agent – to bring out the natural smoky flavor of tender brisket. Simply rub the spice mixture into the brisket and refrigerate overnight before cooking to maximize the flavor. As an alternative, you can try this seasoning on other cuts of beef or even poultry and fish.
170017.categoryPath: H-E-B > Shop > Pantry > Spices & seasonings > Spice mixes

170018.displayName: Bolner's Fiesta Salt-Free Chicken Fajita Seasoning
170018.productDescription:
Fiesta Brand Salt-Free Chicken Fajita Seasoning is the perfect blend of garlic, onion and butter flavors complimented with hints of lemon and a tenderizing agent.
Fajitas are a type of Tex-Mex cuisine, the name for which is derived from the Mexican term for “little meat strips.” This dish typically consists of grilled strips of chicken or beef served with sautéed peppers and onions on a flour or corn tortilla. To enjoy authentic fajitas you do not have to travel all the way to Mexico – you simply need to head to your kitchen and bring out a bottle of Fiesta Brand Salt-Free Chicken Fajita Seasoning. Sprinkle the seasoning over boneless chicken breasts and let stand for 30 minutes before searing over an open flame. Slice the chicken into thin strips and serve hot on warmed tortillas with fresh salsa, lettuce and shredded cheese.

A flavorful blend of garlic, onion, and Mexican spices, Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Spanish Rice Seasoning yields perfectly tender Spanish rice each and every time.
Though the name of this dish may suggest otherwise, Spanish rice did not originate in Spain. This dish is popular throughout the American Southwest and likely has origins in Mexican cuisine, though the name “Spanish rice” is not used by Mexicans or enthusiasts of Mexican cuisine. Spanish rice is a side dish made from cooked white rice, tomatoes, onions, and garlic seasoned with various Mexican spices. This dish is traditionally prepared in a heavy skillet and sautéed until golden brown. After the rice is browned, water or chicken broth is added along with tomato sauce to make it tender. If you are craving the authentic flavor of Spanish rice but don’t live close to the border, try Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Spanish Rice Seasoning.

Fiesta Brand Sugar and Cinnamon blend is made with the finest Indonesian korintje cinnamon, guaranteed to provide bold cinnamon flavor. This flavor is deliciously offset by sweet sugar, making it the perfect combination to sprinkle on your homemade desserts. Use Fiesta Brand Sugar and Cinnamon blend to sprinkle over freshly baked cookies or as a topping for homemade pies – you can even use it on vanilla ice cream for a subtle hint of flavor. If you are craving that authentic Mexican flavor for your tacos, look no further than Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Taco Seasoning – a flavorful blend of garlic, paprika and spices, this taco seasoning is the only one you will ever use.
The taco is a traditional Mexican dish composed of wheat or corn tortillas rolled around a meat or vegetable filling. Tacos can be made with all kinds of meat and seafood – they can also be made with vegetables and cheese for a vegetarian option. The best part about tacos is that they are incredibly easy to make, especially if you use Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Taco Seasoning! Simply stir 1 tablespoon of seasoning into 1 lbs. of ground meat then add ½ cup water and simmer to perfection. Spoon your taco filling into warmed tortillas and top with shredded lettuce, chopped tomato, and fresh cilantro leaves for a burst of fresh flavor.

169876.productDescription:
Making authentic, tasting, Mexican-style tamales has never been easier than with Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Tamale Fixin’s Kit.
The tamale is a traditional Mesoamerican dish made from a corn-based dough wrapped in corn shucks and boiled or steamed. This cuisine is thought to have originated with ancient Aztec and Mayan civilizations as early as 8,000 to 5,000 B.C. but they are still an important part of modern Mexican and Central American cuisine. Traditionally, making tamales can be a labor-intensive process, often practiced during holidays and festivals. Using Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Tamale Fixin’s Kit, however, you can enjoy homemade, authentic-tasting tamales any time of year. This kit includes corn shucks as well as seasoning blends for your tamale filling and masa. Simply prepare your filling and masa according to the directions then assemble your tamales and enjoy!

169909.productDescription:
There is simply no substitute for freshly ground pepper and Bolner’s Fiesta Brand Whole Black Pepper is the best of the best.
Fiesta Brand Whole Black Pepper is of the highest quality, imported directly from India and Indonesia and made available for you to use in all of your favorite recipes. If you are looking for that freshly-ground flavor, there is no other option than to use whole black pepper – simply place it in a peppermill and grind as much or as little as you need in the moment. Whole Black Pepper can be used to season a variety of dishes including classics like pepper steak or simply as a seasoning for grilled meats. You may even want to keep a peppermill full of Whole Black Pepper on your table so you can enjoy freshly ground pepper with all of your meals.

12146015.displayName: CAFE Olé by H-E-B Reserve Single Origin Whole Bean Colombia Anaerobic Coffee
12146015.productDescription:
Colombian mountain ranges provide the perfect setting for cultivating Arabica coffee. The high altitude of 5,906 — 6,562 feet, rich volcanic soil, warm temps and plenty of rain and sun all contribute to the distinctive flavor of these CAFE Olé by H-E-B Reserve Colombia Anaerobic coffee beans. On the Finca Paisandu Estate, an anaerobic fermentation process is used, which starts with hand-picking ripe coffee cherries. The next day, they're placed in a sealed, oxygen-free fermentation tank before sun-drying on African drying beds for 2 — 3 weeks. Bring home this premium single-origin coffee for a gourmet-quality cup. Although a French press or pour-over brewer is recommended, a drip coffeemaker works as well.

Run by the Amaya family, the estate is home to Bourbon and Catuai coffee. Grown at 5,315 — 5,577 feet, the coffee cherries are honey-processed, which means they're picked at their ripest, fermented for 48 hours and dried on African drying beds without being washed. 12146014.displayName: CAFE Olé by H-E-B Reserve Single Origin Whole Bean Tanzania Coffee

Sourced from the Lyamungo Estate that's at the base of Mount Kilimanjaro in Northern Tanzania, these CAFE Olé by H-E-B Reserve coffee beans grow at an elevation of 3,608 — 4,560 feet in mineral-rich volcanic soil. Coffee cherries are picked by hand and processed using a pulper to remove the skin. From there, the beans are moved to fermentation tanks for 16 hours, where they're brushed into water channels to remove any remaining coating. After laying out on drying tables, they're carefully checked before being placed onto raised sun-drying tables. Depending on the weather, the drying process can take anywhere from a few days to a few weeks. Bring home the gourmet smoothness of Tanzania coffee. Iced coffee just got easier with CAFE Olé Brew Over Ice! No need to waste money at an expensive coffee shop when you can get quality iced coffee with the push of a button. These 2.0-compatible single serve pods stand up to ice and make your refreshing home brew better. Each cinnamon, chocolate, and vanilla-flavored pod uses 100% Arabica ground and instant medium roast coffee. It's the perfect Taste of Texas!

Do not use glass when brewing. We recommend your favorite tumbler.

• 12 Taste of San Antonio single serve cups
• Formulated to stand up to ice
• Medium-bodied with cinnamon, chocolate, and vanilla flavors
• Medium Roast Coffee
• 100% Arabica ground and instant coffee
• Do not brew with glass

Directions:
1) Fill heat safe tumbler with ice. *WARNING: DO NOT BREW DIRECTLY INTO GLASS CONTAINER WITH ICE, THIS COULD CAUSE GLASS TO BREAK
2) Place tumbler under brewer and brew 6 oz or 8 oz of coffee depending on desired strength.
3) Add cream, sweetener, or any of your favorite mix-ins as desired, stir and enjoy!

12374024.productDescription:
When you pop open a bag of Central Market Totopos tortilla chips, you may not realize you're munching on an ancient Oaxacan-style snack. Believed to have originated from the Zapotec civilization of the Valley of Oaxaca, the technique for making totopos includes cutting nixtamalized corn tortillas into triangles and frying them in oil. This time-tested method results in a satisfyingly crunchy chip that’s thick enough to handle the heaviest guacamole and the gooiest queso.

What’s Nixtamalized Corn?
Nixtamalization is an ancient Mesoamerican technique of processing corn to make various foods. Raw corn is cooked in water with lime and then ground to become masa.

14264513.displayName: Central Market Whole Peeled Datterino Tomatoes in Juice
14264513.productDescription:
Once you've tasted a datterino tomato you'll never think of the saying "to-may-to, to-mah-to" in the same way again! These vibrant red datterino tomatoes are left to ripen under the warm Mediterranean sun, allowing them to develop a well-balanced flavor profile that sings with super-sweetness and minimal acidity. Hand-picked when perfectly ripe, only the best make it to your table.

Compared to cherry and grape tomatoes, datterino tomatoes offer a naturally sweeter and more intense flavor profile, making them a favorite for those seeking a richer taste. These little gems are ideal for adding depth to your favorite sauces! Central Market Red Datterino Tomatoes open up a new word of culinary possibilities!

These striking pizzutello tomatoes are left to ripen under the warm Mediterranean sun, allowing them to develop a well-balanced flavor profile that sings with sweetness and minimal acidity. Central Market® Pizzutello Tomatoes open up a new world of culinary possibilities!

What is Chai?
Sweet, slightly spicy and creamy, chai is a type of black tea. In the Hindi language, the word “chai” means “tea.” Made with a blend of spices, milk, water and sweetener, this hot steamy beverage is popular all over the world, but especially in India and other parts of South Asia. Not just limited to the morning time, it’s often enjoyed several times a day and is thought to bring people together as they catch up on their day.

8995025.productDescription:
Offering an excellent source of 8 vitamins and minerals, H-E-B Corn Squares cereal is great for breakfast time and more. Oven-toasted for that crisp crunch, these puffy, gridded squares are a key ingredient for making your favorite party snack mix (see recipe below). Gluten-free.

• Corn Squares breakfast cereal
• Excellent source of 8 vitamins and minerals
• Select Ingredients: No artificial flavors, added colors or certified synthetic colors
• Great for making a party snack mix
• Gluten-free

Sweet & Spicy Snack Mix
9 cups H-E-B Corn Squares cereal
1 cup mini pretzels twists
1 cup mini pretzel rods
2 cups broken pita chips or mini crackers
2 cups mixed nuts

For Seasoning Sauce:
¾ cup melted butter
2 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
½ cups honey
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
1 tsp cayenne pepper
1 tsp chili powder

Preheat oven to 250°F (120°C). In a large bowl, add cereal, pretzels, pita chips/crackers and nuts. In a microwave-safe bowl, melt butter. Add Worcestershire sauce, honey, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, cayenne pepper and chili powder to melted butter and mix well. Pour the seasoning sauce over the dry snack mix. Using a spatula, mix to coat all dry ingredients evenly. Transfer snack mix onto a baking tray and spread evenly. Bake in preheated oven at 250°F for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until mixture is even toasted and crunchy, stirring every 15 minutes.

How Many Cups Per Day?

Find your dog’s weight below and use a standard 8-oz measuring cup.
3 – 12 lbs: ⅓ – 1 cup
13 – 20 lbs: 1 – 1-½ cups
21 – 35 lbs: 1-½ cups – 2-¼ cups
36 – 50 lbs: 2-¼ – 3 cups
51 – 75 lbs: 3 – 4 cups
76 – 100 lbs: 4 – 5 cups
100+ lbs: 5 cups*

*Add 1/3 cup for every 10 lbs of body weight over 100 lbs.

Food intake requirements vary depending on age, activity and environment and should be adjusted accordingly to maintain optimum body condition.

About H-E-B Sushiya®
Launched in 2002 with the guidance of Glen Gondo and Hana Lee, owners of Tokyo Gardens Catering, H-E-B Sushiya Sushi House sources sashimi-grade seafood that's sustainably caught or responsibly raised. And with so many varieties to choose from, from sushi rolls to poke bowls to potstickers, there’s something for everyone. Glen and Hana are proud partners of H-E-B and are extremely active in supporting the American Asian Pacific Islander community.

5386521.displayName: Heritage Ranch by H-E-B Adult Dry Dog Food - Beef & Brown Rice
5386521.productDescription:
Get ready for lots of tail-wagging when you pour Heritage Ranch by H-E-B dry adult dog food into their bowl. With real USA beef as the first ingredient, this kibble recipe also has brown rice and fiber-rich vegetables that help support a healthy digestive tract. Plus, there’s Omega-3 and Omega-6 for their joints and a shiny coat, as well as L-Carnitine for a healthy weight.

• 15-lb bag of dry dog food for adult dogs
• Omega-3 and Omega-6 (joint health and a shiny coat)
• L-Carnitine (healthy weight)
• Made with USA beef (first ingredient), brown rice and vegetables
• Crafted in the USA with carefully selected ingredients from around the world
• No added wheat, corn, soy or poultry by-product meal
• Select Ingredients: No artificial flavors, artificial preservatives or added colors
• Calorie Content: 3,526 kcal/kg (367 kcal/cup)

How Many Cups Per Day?
Find your dog's weight below and use a standard 8-oz measuring cup.

Toy (3 - 12 lbs): ⅓ – 1 cup
Small (13 - 25 lbs): 1 – 1-¾ cups
Medium (26 - 50 lbs): 2 – 3 cups
Large (51 - 100 lbs): 3 – 5 cups
Extra Large (100+ lbs): 5 cups*
*Add 1/3 cup for every 10 lbs of body weight over 100 lbs.

Food intake requirements vary depending on age, activity and environment. Adjust accordingly to maintain optimum body condition.

Feeding for growth:
Puppies 4 weeks – 6 months: Approximately 1/3 – 1/2 cup for every 2 lbs of body weight
Puppies 6 months – 12 months: Approximately 1/4 – 1/3 cup for every 2 lbs of body weight

Feeding for Reproduction:
During gestation, food consumption may vary. Feed the amount needed to maintain a pregnant female's good body condition. During lactation, food intake may double or even quadruple.

This dog food is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO (Association of American Feed Control Officials) Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for growth and maintenance, including growth of large-size dogs (70 lbs or more as an adult).

How to Switch to New Dog Food
Start by substituting a small amount of your dog's current food with Heritage Ranch by H-E-B. Over the next 7 – 10 days, gradually increase the amount of Heritage Ranch while decreasing the amount of your dog's previous food.

How Many Cups Per Day?
Find your dog’s weight below and use a standard 8-oz measuring cup.

3 – 12 lbs: ½ – 1 ¼ cups
13 – 25 lbs: 1-¼ – 2 cups
26 – 50 lbs: 2 – 3-¼ cups
51 – 100 lbs: 3-¼ – 5-½ cups
100+ lbs: 5-½ cups plus ½ cup for each 10 lbs of body weight over 100 lbs.

Hill Country Fare Bite Size dog food is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO dog food nutrient profiles for maintenance of adult dogs.
